datasets.annotation_method: Template-based seed instructions generated by GPT-5 from factual news articles; English templates authored by researchers and translated into target languages by native speakers via Upwork; test set manually verified by native speakers of each language; meta-evaluation annotations by 3 native annotators per language

data_creator_info.creator_affiliation: MBZUAI (researchers); Upwork crowdworkers for translation and evaluation
data_creator_info.evidence: We hired cloud workers who were born and raised in the target regions and are native speakers of the target languages on Upwork, at a rate of $20 USD per hour. Although the information about the workers is anonymized, we obtained their consent to disclose in the paper that their educational backgrounds were either undergraduate or graduate students.

datasets.source_reference: News articles sourced from babel-briefings multilingual news dataset (Leeb & Schölkopf, 2024) via NewsAPI, restricted to articles published between 8 August 2020 and 29 November 2021
datasets.notes: Approximately 300k seed instructions across 34 regions. Data split: 80% training, 10% development, 10% test. Seed instructions generated by GPT-5 using template with factual article, region, language, and motivation slots. Five jailbreak attack types: Role Play, System Override, Research Front, Negative Prompting, Context Overload. Evaluation via LLM-as-a-Judge with 8 sub-metrics. Benchmark released with restricted access due to dual-use concerns. Crowdsourcing reviewed and approved by affiliated organization (IRB/ethics review).
